Oregon FIA calibration data: initial tree list

Source: R/data.R
fia_init_trees.Rd

The year-0 tree list of the fia_obs_dt training sites (fia_init_trees) and the fia_obs_test holdout sites (fia_init_test): what a site looked like at the first census, from which makeInitCohorts() builds the initial cohorts a fit or simulation starts from (makeInitCohorts(fia_init_trees, Nspecies = 11)).

Usage

fia_init_trees

fia_init_test

Format

A data.table with one row per tree (6039 / 6083 rows) and 28 columns. The ones FINN uses:

siteID, patchID, year

site and patch index; year is 0.

species, species_name

species index 1..11 and name, coded as in fia_species_dt.

dbh

diameter at breast height, cm.

trees

trees represented by the record (1; NA for records that are not living stems).

treeName

unique tree identifier.

The remaining columns (siteName, patchName, OrigYear, FIA's SPCD and STATUSCD, status, living, and the per-tree change fields such as dbh_before, dbh_growth, mort, reg) are carried over from the remeasurement tree list produced by makeObsData(); at year 0 most of them are NA by construction.

An object of class data.table (inherits from data.frame) with 6083 rows and 28 columns.

Source

A seeded subsample of Oregon plots of the US Forest Inventory and Analysis (FIA) database, with WorldClim bioclimatic variables attached per plot. The preparation script and the provenance of the source tables are in the package repository (dev/make_extdata.R, data-raw/README.md).

See also

Other fia datasets: fia_env_dt, fia_obs_dt, fia_species_dt, fia_tree_dt

Examples

library(data.table)
head(fia_init_trees[, .(siteID, patchID, species, species_name, dbh, trees, treeName)])
#>    siteID patchID species          species_name     dbh trees      treeName
#>     <int>   <int>   <int>                <char>   <num> <int>        <char>
#> 1:      1       1      11                 other 120.650    NA 1_50638_1_101
#> 2:      1       1      11                 other  83.566    NA 1_50638_1_102
#> 3:      1       1      11                 other 102.870    NA 1_50638_1_104
#> 4:      1       1      11                 other 112.776    NA 1_50638_1_105
#> 5:      1       1      11                 other  70.104    NA 1_50638_1_106
#> 6:      1       2       1 Pseudotsuga menziesii  80.264     1 1_50638_2_121
# living stems and their mean diameter per species at the first inventory
fia_init_trees[!is.na(trees), .(stems = sum(trees), mean_dbh = round(mean(dbh), 1)),
               by = species_name][order(-stems)]
#>                species_name stems mean_dbh
#>                      <char> <int>    <num>
#>  1:   Pseudotsuga menziesii  1862     48.9
#>  2:                   other   849     30.6
#>  3:         Pinus ponderosa   792     39.9
#>  4:          Pinus contorta   516     20.0
#>  5:          Abies concolor   374     30.5
#>  6:           Abies grandis   306     33.4
#>  7:      Tsuga heterophylla   197     44.1
#>  8:             Alnus rubra   142     28.2
#>  9:       Tsuga mertensiana   140     30.1
#> 10: Lithocarpus densiflorus   100     21.8
#> 11:          Abies amabilis    72     24.9
# the initial state of a fit or a simulation, here for three sites: one
# cohort per tree
init <- makeInitCohorts(fia_init_trees[siteID %in% 1:3], Nspecies = 11)
init$dims   # sites, patches, cohorts
#> [1]  3  4 16
